PM Modi Praises Australian Law, Sparks Speculation on India's Social Media Rules for Minors

Prime Minister Narendra Modi has praised Australia's law regarding social media use by children, leading to speculation about potential similar measures in India. Reports suggest discussions about banning or restricting social media access for minors under 16. The Prime Minister's comments were made during his visit to Australia.
